package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net"
)

func main() {
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:38171")
	if err == nil {
		fmt.Println("tcp=fake-listener")
		listener.Close()
	} else if errors.Is(err, errors.ErrUnsupported) {
		fmt.Println("tcp=unsupported")
	} else {
		panic("unexpected TCP result")
	}
	packet, err := net.ListenPacket("udp", "127.0.0.1:38172")
	if err == nil {
		fmt.Println("udp=fake-listener")
		packet.Close()
	} else if errors.Is(err, errors.ErrUnsupported) {
		fmt.Println("udp=unsupported")
	} else {
		panic("unexpected UDP result")
	}
}
